title: Fixed rules shows a loading indicator and cannot be used until loaded
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} has a large number of fixed rules (for example 2,000 or more), so the Fixed rules tab takes a few seconds to load.
  • Search term {Term-A} (for example zzautotest) is any short text.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. While the tab is still loading, click the Category column header.
  4. While the tab is still loading, click in the Search box.
  5. Type {Term-A}.
  6. While the tab is still loading, click inside the list area.
  7. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  8. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  9. Look at the three column headers, the Search box and the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: a loading indicator shows on the Fixed rules tab.
  • Steps 3 to 6: nothing responds. No arrow appears on Category, no text appears in the Search box and nothing opens.
  • Step 9: only Part Number shows an arrow, pointing up, the Search box is empty and the list shows every rule.
  • Steps 3 to 6: if the tab finished loading before you could try them, write 'not checked by hand: loaded too quickly' in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-R19, §6 Assumptions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment: Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 882311473), first comment item 4: loading indicator, not interactive until ready. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R19: “While the rules load, the Fixed Rules tab shows a loading indicator, and its column headers, search box and rows cannot be used until every rule has loaded.”
  • S3-R12: “The list opens sorted by Part number ascending (numeric-aware, per S3-R6), and that header shows the ascending arrow.”
  • PRD §6 Assumptions: “At that size the Fixed Rules tab takes a few seconds to load before it can be sorted, which is why S3-R19 exists.”
